podcast.title: Best New Artist "Kiss of Death" (1977)
podcast.body: The Starland Vocal Band's Best New Artist Grammy win in 1977 proved to be detrimental to their career, as they never charted again afterward. Vocalist Taffy Nivert famously remarked that the prize was "the kiss of death." "Vocalist Taffy Nivert later called the best new artist prize, quote, the kiss of death, unquote."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Grammy Award for Best New Artist (1977)
podcast.body: The band won the Grammy for Best New Artist in 1977, though the transcript suggests Grammy voters "missed the mark" as "Afternoon Delight" was the peak of their career. "starland vocal band would go on to win the Grammy for best new artist in 1977 uh the Grammy voters missed the mark on that one afternoon delight was the peak of the career for starland vocal band."

podcast.title: Infamous One Hit Wonder Status
podcast.body: The Starland Vocal Band gained notoriety as an "infamous One Hit Wonder Act" after winning the Best New Artist Grammy in 1977. Despite the award, they "never hit the charts again," leading vocalist Taffy Nivert to famously call the prize "the kiss of death." "Perhaps most notorious, the same year songs in the key of life took album of the year, best new artist went to infamous One Hit Wonder Act, the Starland Vocal Band."
